skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the concepts and roles of project quality management.
Understand the functions of the Project Management Board and coordination between different departments in project quality management.

Master the process and methods of quality management, project quality management, ensuring project quality, planning project quality, controlling project quality, comprehensive project quality management.

Master and practice the contents of quality management, project quality management, ensuring project quality, planning project quality, controlling project quality, comprehensive project quality management.
Recognize factors affecting project quality management and apply appropriate tools to evaluate the work of project quality management in enterprises and organizations.

Apply knowledge about ensuring project quality, planning project quality, controlling project quality, comprehensive project quality management to manage project quality.
